# Mayville Engineering Company Completes Acquisition of Accu‑Fab, LLC


[Back to MEC News](https://www.mecinc.com/news/)


July 1, 2025


“The acquisition of Accu-Fab is a pivotal step in our MBX value creation journey,” said Jag Reddy, President & CEO. “It strengthens our position in high-growth, mission-critical markets and unites two teams committed to quality, service, and innovation. We’re energized by the long-term value this partnership will unlock.”


Click[here](https://ir.mecinc.com/news/news-details/2025/Mayville-Engineering-Company-Completes-Acquisition-of-AccuFab-LLC/default.aspx) to read the complete press release.
